question: Which of the following hill stations is located in the Middle Himalayas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darjeeling**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Darjeeling is located in the **Middle Himalayas in West Bengal**.
 
• It is famous for the **distinctive black tea** grown on plantations that dot its surrounding slopes.
 
• It is also called **“Queen of the Hills” **located in North East India.
 
• It is famous for the **world heritage Darjeeling Himalayan Railway**.
 
• The area is drained by the river **Teesta**.
